name: Budgeting
overview: Scripture teaches that wise budgeting honors the Lord by managing resources diligently and with intentionality. Believers are encouraged to plan carefully, seek counsel, and avoid hastiness, as diligence leads to abundance while impulsiveness results in lack. The prudent save and preserve treasures, unlike the foolish who squander, recognizing that debt places one in servitude to another. Ultimately, budgeting reflects a heart that honors God with the firstfruits and follows the wisdom evident in creation and counsel.
